dlg.felix.worried.1.0: The pond's too still. Fish go deep when something's coming. I don't know what.
dlg.felix.farm.1.0: Your fields look good. Bring me a few crabs one day. I'll trade you a story.
dlg.felix.farm.2.0: Cows on the farm? Don't let them near the pond. They stare at the fish.
dlg.felix.fest.1.0: Festival soon. I'll bring a fish stew. The fish agreed. Mostly.
dlg.felix.fest.2.0: Festival day. The stall's shut, the pond's calm, and I'm about to eat a great deal.
dlg.felix.bday.1.0: My birthday's close. I'll fish. If the tuna comes, I'll say it's a present.
dlg.felix.bday.2.0: Somebody remembered. I'll cast a line in your honor. It won't catch anything. It's the thought.
dlg.felix.bday.3.0: Tilda's birthday. I'll bring her a fish she'll refuse. It's how we say happy birthday.
dlg.felix.rare.1.0: I once pulled up a boot with a clock in it. The clock was right. The boot was not.
dlg.felix.rare.2.0: The first fish I ever caught, I let go. It's been looking for me ever since. I'm sure of it.
dlg.felix.rare.3.0: Come on. (He points at the horizon.) Dawn's in an hour. I saved you the best rock. Bring your line.
dlg.npc.felix.gift.item.fish.tuna.0: A tuna! You've a gift for it. I'll put it on ice. Then I'll look at it for an hour.
dlg.npc.felix.gift.item.fish.sturgeon.0: A sturgeon! Oh, that's a good one. Almost as big as the one that got away. Almost.
dlg.npc.felix.gift.cat.Fish.0: A fish. Fine specimen. I'll admire it, and then I'll steal its technique.
dlg.npc.felix.gift.item.fish.carp.0: Carp. Humble and clever. I'll keep it company. Then I'll fry it.
A seashell. I hold it to my ear. It says "Tide's coming." Always true.
dlg.npc.felix.gift.item.fish.sea_bass.0: Sea bass. A fine-looking fish. I'll say a small word of thanks over it.
dlg.npc.felix.gift.item.forage.dandelion: A dandelion. I'll use it as a bobber. It won't help. It's a nice thought.
dlg.npc.felix.gift.item.crop.kale.0: Kale. Fish don't care for it. Neither do I. I'll respect it from a distance.
dlg.npc.felix.gift.item.crop.cucumber.0: A cucumber. Cold, green and a bit smug. I'll use it as bait. Tell nobody.
dlg.npc.felix.gift.repeat.0: Another one! You spoil me. I'll write it in the tide table, next to dawn.
dlg.ione.spring.1.0: Spring. The almanac's open on the desk, and half the readers come to see what it predicts.
dlg.ione.spring.2.0: New season, new returns. The box is sticky, but the books are cheerful about it.
dlg.ione.spring.3.0: Someone returned a book on bees with a bee still inside. It was very polite. It left.
dlg.ione.summer.1.0: Summer. The library's the coolest room in Wetherell. People "browse" for a very long time.
dlg.ione.summer.2.0: I keep the windows open. The pages turn on their own. It's the nicest kind of reader.
dlg.ione.summer.3.0: On summer evenings I walk to the beach. The sea reads in a language I almost know.
dlg.ione.fall.1.0: Fall. The shelves feel warmer. Everyone suddenly wants a long book and a short day.
dlg.ione.fall.2.0: Leaves in the returns box. I don't remove them. They're also borrowing something.
dlg.ione.fall.3.0: Harvest week, people read by the window and say very little. It's my favorite sound.
dlg.ione.winter.1.0: Winter. The stove, the lamp, a very long novel. My birthday's in winter. I read through it.
dlg.ione.winter.2.0: The first snow's my favorite day. I stand at the window. The books wait politely.
dlg.ione.winter.3.0: Snow on the sill. Frost on the glass. A reader asleep with a book on their face. Perfect.
dlg.ione.mon.1.0: Monday. New week, same shelves. I rearranged one. Hazel noticed in under a minute.
dlg.ione.tue.1.0: Tuesday. Wren's saloon is shut, so the saloon's gossip arrives here. Slightly bound.
dlg.ione.wed.1.0: Wednesday. Marcus returned a book on joinery. Early. Without a word. Bram did the same, yesterday.
dlg.ione.thu.1.0: Thursday. Felix's day off. He borrows tide tables and returns them smelling of fish.
dlg.ione.fri.1.0: Friday. Everyone remembers they wanted a book for the weekend. I keep a few ready.
dlg.ione.sat.1.0: Saturday. The library's shut, and I'm in the forest. A walk is a book without a spine.
dlg.ione.sun.1.0: Sunday. A quiet day. I read the first page of every book, in turn, to say hello.
dlg.ione.sunny.1.0: A bright day. The dust looks like glitter. The books are showing off.
dlg.ione.sunny.2.0: Sun on the spines. They warm up like cats. It's very hard to shelve them then.
dlg.ione.rain.2.0: Rain on the windows is the best reading weather. I've set a chair out for it.
dlg.ione.rain.3.0: Wet streets, dry pages. A reader by the stove and a sentence that keeps going. Lovely.
dlg.ione.storm.1.0: Thunder. I light a candle and read aloud to the books. They've heard worse.
dlg.ione.storm.2.0: A storm turns the whole library into a very big, very old boat. I like it.
dlg.ione.snow.1.0: Snow. The reading room's gone quiet. Even the clock is tiptoeing.
dlg.ione.snow.2.0: Snow means nobody comes. Everyone comes. A paradox, and a warm one.
dlg.ione.wind.1.0: Windy. The shutters knock. It sounds like someone asking to be let in with a book.
dlg.ione.wind.2.0: Gusts rattle the glass. I've weighted the loose papers with a very small marble.
dlg.ione.morning.1.0: Early. The library smells of paper, dust and possibility. In that order.
dlg.ione.morning.2.0: Opening the shutters. The first light slides across a shelf. Every spine blinks.
dlg.ione.midday.1.0: Midday. Readers drift in, mostly to be quiet near the stove. A fair trade.
dlg.ione.midday.2.0: A busy hour, by library standards. Three people. One of them is the cat.
dlg.ione.evening.1.0: Nearly closing. I set a book aside for tomorrow's first reader. I always know who.
dlg.ione.evening.2.0: Evening. The light goes gold on the spines. I lower my voice, even when alone.
dlg.ione.late.1.0: Late. The lamp's low, the page is warm, and the world is somebody else's problem.
dlg.ione.late.2.0: After closing. I read the margins. Previous readers left kind notes.
dlg.ione.here.1.0: Take your time. Everything here is older than it looks. Including the chairs.
dlg.ione.here.2.0: The returns box is sticky. We've discussed it. It's decided to stay that way.
dlg.ione.here.3.0: I set something aside for you. It's on the desk. It's very short. It's very good.
dlg.ione.fr.1.0: There's a book on the desk with your name on a slip. Farming. Beautifully drawn.
dlg.ione.fr.2.0: Talking to you is easy. I'd forgotten conversation could be restful.
dlg.ione.fr.3.0: Hazel says I smile at you more than at the books. The books are fine with it.
dlg.ione.fr.4.0: You return things on time. I noticed. I'm quietly delighted.
dlg.ione.fr.5.0: A reader who stays for tea is the best kind. I'll put the kettle on.
dlg.ione.cl.1.0: I once read about farms like [farm]. None was as good as the real one.
dlg.ione.cl.2.0: Visit whenever, with or without a question. The shelves appreciate the company.
dlg.ione.cl.3.0: I worry sometimes there are more stories here than readers. You help the numbers.
dlg.ione.cl.4.0: There's a shelf I haven't shown anyone. Books set aside for people who never came.
dlg.ione.cl.5.0: The sea in winter is the one book I've never finished. I'd like to read it with you.
dlg.ione.co.1.0: I set something aside for you, years ago, before we'd met. It's the shelf. It's yours.
dlg.ione.co.2.0: I used to count the readers. Now I count the days you come in.
dlg.ione.co.3.0: If I wrote you a letter, it would be a very long footnote to a very short sentence.
dlg.ione.co.4.0: Thank you, [player]. The whole library knows. It's trying to be quiet about it.
dlg.ione.lonely.1.0: A quiet week. I read the dictionary aloud. It's a very good listener.
dlg.ione.tired.1.0: A long day of shelving. My arms are two very tired bookends.
dlg.ione.delighted.1.0: Someone borrowed the oldest book in the room! I'm dancing, in a small, reserved way.
dlg.ione.mischief.1.0: I hid a note in the poetry shelf. Hazel hasn't found it. She's been looking for an hour.
dlg.ione.worried.1.0: The roof leaks onto the maps. I've moved them. They sighed.
dlg.ione.farm.1.0: Your fields are coming along. I've a book on soil that's mostly poetry. You'll like it.
dlg.ione.farm.2.0: Animals? I'll set a book aside on husbandry. It's a lovely word for a hard job.
dlg.ione.fest.1.0: Festival soon. The library will be nearly empty. I'll be at the soup, with a book.
dlg.ione.fest.2.0: Festival day. I've left a sign: "Back after pie." It will be true for hours.
dlg.ione.bday.1.0: My birthday's near. I don't make a fuss. I read a new book on the day. That's the fuss.
dlg.ione.bday.2.0: You remembered. I'll put a bookmark here, in this moment. Thank you.
dlg.ione.bday.3.0: Hazel's birthday. I've set aside a very small, very exact book. She'll pretend she didn't need it.
dlg.ione.rare.1.0: Overdue is a state of mind. I've been overdue on sleep since the nineties.
dlg.ione.rare.2.0: The first book I ever shelved here was this one. I still read it, to be sure it's all right.
dlg.ione.rare.3.0: Come with me. (A small bell rings on the desk.) That's your shelf. I set the first book aside the day you arrived.
dlg.npc.ione.gift.item.forage.pearl.0: A pearl. Small and round and very quiet. I'll keep it in the front of a favorite book.
dlg.npc.ione.gift.item.forage.snowdrop.0: A snowdrop. The first brave thing of the year. I'll press it between two very old pages.
dlg.npc.ione.gift.item.forage.elderflowe: Elderflower. My mother kept some in her books. The whole shelf smells like summer.
dlg.npc.ione.gift.item.forage.seashell.0: A seashell. I'll hold it to my ear. It says "Come visit." I'm writing back.
dlg.npc.ione.gift.item.crop.kale.0: Kale. A sensible leaf. I'll eat it at the desk, next to a very dull book.
dlg.npc.ione.gift.item.forage.blackberry: Blackberries. Dark and sweet. I'll try not to stain a page. I will stain a page.
dlg.npc.ione.gift.item.resource.stone.0: A stone. Hm. A paperweight in waiting. I'll find it a very important pile.
dlg.npc.ione.gift.item.resource.wood.0: Wood. For the stove. Marcus will approve. The books will be warmer.
dlg.npc.ione.gift.item.resource.coal.0: Coal. It will get on everything. I'll keep it far from the poetry shelf.
dlg.npc.ione.gift.repeat.0: Another one. Thank you. I'll set it aside with the first. They'll be good company.
dlg.marcus.spring.1.0: Spring brings barns and fences. Frost heave does half my work. I do the rest.
dlg.marcus.spring.2.0: New lumber smells like a beginning. I keep a plank by the door to remind me.
dlg.marcus.spring.3.0: Everyone wants a shed in April. Nobody wants a shed in February. Wood has no calendar. People do.
dlg.marcus.summer.1.0: Summer is for greenhouses. Glass and patience. Mostly patience.
dlg.marcus.summer.2.0: The workshop door stays open. The sawdust drifts out. The birds come to look.
dlg.marcus.summer.3.0: My birthday's in summer. I plane a plank for it. Nothing fancy. A straight board.
dlg.marcus.fall.1.0: Fall: coops, sheds, anything that keeps winter out. Measure twice. The weather doesn't.
dlg.marcus.fall.2.0: The oak comes in this month. Slow wood. Honest wood. I'd rather work with it than most things.
dlg.marcus.fall.3.0: The hall's roof gets a look every fall. It's nearly fixed. Nearly is a respectable word.
dlg.marcus.winter.1.0: Winter is for furniture. Indoor work. Warm hands, long grain, nothing in a hurry.
dlg.marcus.winter.2.0: Snow on a half-finished roof teaches humility. I've been taught several times.
dlg.marcus.winter.3.0: The workshop stove burns scraps. Nothing wasted. A good shop keeps itself warm.
dlg.marcus.mon.1.0: Monday. Clean bench, sharp chisel. Best day for a first cut.
dlg.marcus.tue.1.0: Tuesday. Wren's closed, so the saloon's loud in my ears anyway. I imagine it.
dlg.marcus.wed.1.0: Wednesday. Shut. I'm on a bench with Bram. Neither of us has said a word. It's good.
dlg.marcus.thu.1.0: Thursday. Felix is off. His boat needs a plank. It always does.
dlg.marcus.fri.1.0: Friday. Orders due Saturday. Sawdust to the ankles. A fair price for being useful.
dlg.marcus.sat.1.0: Saturday. I sweep. Then I plan Monday. Then I sweep again. It's restful.
dlg.marcus.sun.1.0: Sunday. I fix things nobody asked about. It's how I say good morning.
dlg.marcus.sunny.1.0: Good drying weather. Boards behave. So do I.
dlg.marcus.sunny.2.0: Sun on the roof means I can see every joint I got wrong. Honest light.
dlg.marcus.rain.2.0: Rain tests a roof. Mine passes. The hall's does not. Nearly.
dlg.marcus.rain.3.0: A wet day, a warm shop, and the sound of a plane on pine. Hard to beat.
dlg.marcus.storm.1.0: Storm. I check the doors twice. Then a third time, under my breath.
dlg.marcus.storm.2.0: Thunder rattles the shelves. I put a chisel on each one. Good luck charms.
dlg.marcus.snow.1.0: Snow. The shop smells like cedar and chimney. I won't leave until it stops.
dlg.marcus.snow.2.0: A snowy roof is a measuring exercise. Weight, pitch, hope.
dlg.marcus.wind.1.0: Wind finds every loose nail. I've got a list. It's long.
dlg.marcus.wind.2.0: A gusty day. Doors argue. Good doors win.
dlg.marcus.morning.1.0: Early. First cut of the day is the cleanest. I save it for something that matters.
dlg.marcus.morning.2.0: Morning light on a plank. A man could do worse than watching that.
dlg.marcus.midday.1.0: Midday. Plane in hand, lunch in the drawer. I eat when the shaving curls say so.
dlg.marcus.midday.2.0: Busy hour. Don't stand where the board swings.
dlg.marcus.evening.1.0: Evening. I sweep the shop and tell the floor it did well.
dlg.marcus.evening.2.0: Last cut of the day. I make it a good one. Tomorrow starts clean.
dlg.marcus.late.1.0: Late. The lamp's on, the stove's on, and the roof plans are on the table. Again.
dlg.marcus.late.2.0: Quiet shop. A sleeping saw. A man could think. I do. Mostly about joints.
dlg.marcus.here.1.0: Mind the sawdust. It gets into everything. It's good for the soul.
dlg.marcus.here.2.0: Each tool has its place. Juno labeled them. Now they have two places. Hers and mine.
dlg.marcus.here.3.0: The chair by the stove is Dorian's. He doesn't say so. The cushion does.
dlg.marcus.fr.1.0: You've got good hands, [player]. I noticed when you held the ladder.
dlg.marcus.fr.2.0: Tilda says I'm "reliable". I measured. She's right. I was surprised.
dlg.marcus.fr.3.0: Come by the bench Wednesday. Bram won't say hello. That's his way of saying hello.
dlg.marcus.fr.4.0: I don't build for strangers often. You're not one. Say what you need.
dlg.marcus.fr.5.0: A tool in a good hand is half a conversation. You're the other half.
dlg.marcus.cl.1.0: I built half of this village. [farm] is the part I'd keep if I had to choose.
dlg.marcus.cl.2.0: A good neighbor is worth more than good lumber. I've checked. Twice.
dlg.marcus.cl.3.0: Measure twice. Then ask someone you trust. That's you, now.
dlg.marcus.cl.4.0: The hall roof is not nearly fixed. I'm afraid it won't hold. I'd rather you knew.
dlg.marcus.cl.5.0: Dorian leaves mushrooms on my table and says nothing. You'd get along. You already do.
dlg.marcus.co.1.0: A building lasts if the people in it do. I'd like you in this one for a long time.
dlg.marcus.co.2.0: My father measured three times. I measure twice and trust you for the third.
dlg.marcus.co.3.0: If I wrote you a letter it would be a blueprint. With margins.
dlg.marcus.co.4.0: Thank you, [player]. I'd carve it on a beam, but you'd say it was too much.
dlg.marcus.lonely.1.0: Quiet bench, quiet shop. I planed a plank thin as a leaf just to hear something.
dlg.marcus.tired.1.0: Long week of lifting. My back keeps a ledger. Dr. Penn reads it aloud.
dlg.marcus.delighted.1.0: A perfect joint today. Dry-fit, no gap. I held it up and looked at it for a minute.
dlg.marcus.mischief.1.0: I told Juno one of her labels is crooked. It isn't. She's been measuring for an hour.
dlg.marcus.worried.1.0: The hall roof again. It leans a hair. Maybe I'm tired. Maybe I'm right.
dlg.marcus.farm.1.0: Your fields are coming in. A good farm wants a good shed. Come by when you're ready.
dlg.marcus.farm.2.0: Animals need a roof. I build coops that outlast the chickens. Both of them.
dlg.marcus.fest.1.0: Festival soon. I'm building the stage. It will hold. It always does. Probably.
dlg.marcus.fest.2.0: Festival. The stage held. I checked it twice and said a short prayer to the glue.
dlg.marcus.bday.1.0: My birthday's close. I'll plane a plank for it. I do every year. A straight board is plenty.
dlg.marcus.bday.2.0: Somebody remembered. I'm not sure what to do with my hands. I'll hold a plank.
dlg.marcus.bday.3.0: Bram's birthday. I'll sit on the bench with him. No words. It's the gift.
dlg.marcus.rare.1.0: I once built a door that wouldn't close. It was beautiful. I kept it as a window.
dlg.marcus.rare.2.0: My father left me a pencil. It's half the size it was. I still measure with it.
dlg.marcus.rare.3.0: Come here. (He taps a beam twice.) That's the first beam I ever cut. I want you to have the offcut.
dlg.npc.marcus.gift.item.resource.wood.0: Oak. Straight grain. I'll make something of it, and the first thing is a thank-you.
dlg.npc.marcus.gift.item.crop.pumpkin.0: A pumpkin. Round, heavy and honest. I'll put it by the bench. Dorian will carve it.
dlg.npc.marcus.gift.item.food.roasted_ro: Roasted roots. The bench lunch. Bram will want a bite. I'll say no. Then yes.
A good stone. Flat on one side. I'll use it for a doorstop and never regret it.
dlg.npc.marcus.gift.item.forage.hazelnut: Hazelnuts. Small, hard and patient. Like a good dovetail.
dlg.npc.marcus.gift.item.resource.copper: Copper. Bram will have a view on that. I'll keep it dry.
dlg.npc.marcus.gift.item.forage.dandelio: A dandelion. Hm. I'll put it in a jar. It deserves a roof.
dlg.npc.marcus.gift.item.crop.kale.0: Kale. I'll pass it to Dorian. He'll know what to do. He knows what to do with leaves.
Slime. On my bench. I'll find a bucket for it. And a very long stick.
dlg.npc.marcus.gift.cat.Fish.0: A fish. Felix is two doors down. I'll walk it over. Then wash my hands. Twice.
dlg.npc.marcus.gift.repeat.0: Another one. Measure twice, thank twice. Thank you.
dlg.odalys.spring.1.0: Spring brings sneezes, sprains and optimism. I treat all three with fluids and a firm tone.
dlg.odalys.spring.2.0: Pollen season. Prescription: one handkerchief, one open window, and no heroics in the field.
dlg.odalys.spring.3.0: Every farmer announces they feel fine. Fine is not a symptom. I check anyway.
dlg.odalys.summer.1.0: Summer: sunburn, thirst and bravado. Drink water. Wear a hat. This is not a suggestion.
dlg.odalys.summer.2.0: The clinic's cooler than the street. Visitors are welcome. They are also, technically, loitering.
dlg.odalys.summer.3.0: Heat tires the body before the mind notices. I advise a nap. I take one. Occasionally.
dlg.odalys.fall.1.0: Fall harvest means backs, wrists and boasting. I prescribe a hot bath and silence.
dlg.odalys.fall.2.0: Cooler air brings colds. Wear wool. Doctor's orders. Don't make me say it twice.
dlg.odalys.fall.3.0: I walk through the leaves after closing. It's not medicine. It simply works.
dlg.odalys.winter.1.0: Winter: chills, chapped hands, and a waiting room full of people who came for the stove.
dlg.odalys.winter.2.0: My birthday's in winter. I take a prescription for it. One hour of sunshine, one bowl of soup.
dlg.odalys.winter.3.0: Frost makes the whole valley hold still. It's good for the lungs and for the thinking.
dlg.odalys.mon.1.0: Monday. The week's complaints arrive in order of volume. I triage by tone.
dlg.odalys.tue.1.0: Tuesday. Wren's closed, so half the village has nowhere to be unwell. Quiet clinic.
dlg.odalys.wed.1.0: Wednesday. Marcus will be on a bench with Bram, ignoring his back. I've left a note.
dlg.odalys.thu.1.0: Thursday. Felix's day off. His hands are chapped. He won't visit. I'll send salve.
dlg.odalys.fri.1.0: Friday. Everyone remembers their ailment before the weekend. It's a medical miracle.
dlg.odalys.sat.1.0: Saturday. The clinic is shut. I am, for the day, a layperson with opinions.
dlg.odalys.sun.1.0: Sunday. I take my own advice. Soup, a book and no patients. It's nearly effective.
dlg.odalys.sunny.1.0: Fine weather. Everyone outdoors is a patient I won't see. I approve.
dlg.odalys.sunny.2.0: Sun is the cheapest tonic. Take twenty minutes. Don't squint heroically.
dlg.odalys.rain.2.0: Rain. Wet feet cause colds. Keep yours dry, or I'll mention it twice.
dlg.odalys.rain.3.0: A quiet rainy afternoon. The kettle ticks. Nobody's dying. I could grow fond of it.
dlg.odalys.storm.1.0: A storm. Stay in. If you can't, wear boots and sensible regrets.
dlg.odalys.storm.2.0: Thunder startles the nervous. Prescription: warm milk and counting seconds between flash and sound.
dlg.odalys.snow.1.0: Snow. Keep gloves on. Frostbite begins as pride and ends as an appointment.
dlg.odalys.snow.2.0: The clinic windows frost over. Elara draws things on them. I allow it.
dlg.odalys.wind.1.0: Wind. Hold your hat and your temper. Both blow away.
dlg.odalys.wind.2.0: Gusts bring grit to the eyes. I recommend squinting with dignity.
dlg.odalys.morning.1.0: Early. The first patient is always a surprise. Often it's me, apologizing to a kettle.
dlg.odalys.morning.2.0: Morning rounds are quiet. I note the sky, the street and who looks tired.
dlg.odalys.midday.1.0: Midday. Busy. Please don't faint on the mat. It's just been scrubbed.
dlg.odalys.midday.2.0: Appointments run long. People start with a splinter and finish with a story.
dlg.odalys.evening.1.0: Closing soon. I'll write the day up and prescribe myself something suitably boring.
dlg.odalys.evening.2.0: Evening. The last patient has left. I've lined the bottles up. It's very calming.
dlg.odalys.late.1.0: Late. I'm reading. It's not a symptom. It's a habit.
dlg.odalys.late.2.0: Past closing, still lit. I do paperwork and drink tea. The tea is medicinal.
dlg.odalys.here.1.0: Sit. Not there, that's Elara's. The wobbly one's yours. It's a diagnostic chair.
dlg.odalys.here.2.0: Every bottle is labeled. Elara added faces. I've decided they are "bedside manner".
dlg.odalys.here.3.0: The skeleton is for teaching. It also keeps the draft out of the corner.
dlg.odalys.fr.1.0: You look well, [player]. I'd like that on record. I rarely say it out loud.
dlg.odalys.fr.2.0: Elara says I smiled at you. It was a muscle spasm. I'm monitoring it.
dlg.odalys.fr.3.0: Sit. That's the closest thing I have to a warm welcome, and I mean it.
dlg.odalys.fr.4.0: Prescription: one cup of tea, ten minutes' conversation, and no talking about work.
dlg.odalys.fr.5.0: Few patients visit when they're well. You do. It's a very good symptom.
dlg.odalys.cl.1.0: I trust your opinion on soil, weather and, increasingly, on me.
dlg.odalys.cl.2.0: You remind me why I took up this work. Not the cures. The company between them.
dlg.odalys.cl.3.0: Doctor's orders: take a day off. I'll take one too, and we'll compare notes.
dlg.odalys.cl.4.0: I don't sleep as I advise. You may report me to Elara. She keeps a list.
dlg.odalys.cl.5.0: The village is healthier than it seems. I count it every night. The numbers are kind.
dlg.odalys.co.1.0: A doctor should be afraid of nothing. I am afraid you'll stop visiting. I've prescribed myself courage.
dlg.odalys.co.2.0: I measure the village by its laughter. Lately it's louder, and half of it is yours.
dlg.odalys.co.3.0: If I wrote you a letter, it would be a case history. Mostly good. A few notes on posture.
dlg.odalys.co.4.0: Thank you, [player]. That's the whole prescription. Take it daily.
dlg.odalys.lonely.1.0: Quiet clinic. I reorganized the shelves. Then I reorganized them back. It passed the time.
dlg.odalys.tired.1.0: A long day. I'm giving myself my own advice, and refusing to listen.
dlg.odalys.delighted.1.0: A good day. Everyone healthy, nobody stubborn, and Elara forgot a joke. Remarkable.
dlg.odalys.mischief.1.0: I hung a sign by the door that says "Cheerful Patients Only". Nobody's come in. Fascinating.
dlg.odalys.worried.1.0: A patient hasn't come back for a week. I'll walk by tomorrow. Carefully. For their health.
dlg.odalys.farm.1.0: Your fields look healthy. Plants don't lie about symptoms. It's why I trust them.
dlg.odalys.farm.2.0: Animals are good for you. Mostly. Wash your hands. I'll say it once more.
dlg.odalys.fest.1.0: Festival soon. I'll be present. In the sense that I will stand next to the soup.
dlg.odalys.fest.2.0: Festival day. I have prescribed myself three treats. For safety.
dlg.odalys.bday.1.0: My birthday is near. I observe it with soup. If you'd like to join, sit.
dlg.odalys.bday.2.0: You remembered. I'll note it in a file labeled "Unexpected". Thank you.
dlg.odalys.bday.3.0: Elara's birthday approaches. I've hidden the good tea. She'll find it. She always does.
dlg.odalys.rare.1.0: I once prescribed laughter to a very serious man. He filed a complaint. It was a good laugh.
dlg.odalys.rare.2.0: I keep a drawer of thank-you notes. I don't read them often. I just open it.
dlg.odalys.rare.3.0: Sit. (She taps her stethoscope twice.) I wrote you a prescription. It says "Come back anyway."
dlg.npc.odalys.gift.item.forage.elderflo: Elderflower. Fresh. For the tonic and, I confess, for the smell. Thank you.
dlg.npc.odalys.gift.item.crop.spinach.0: Spinach. A medicine that tastes like a vegetable. I'll eat it and call it a victory.
dlg.npc.odalys.gift.item.food.salad.0: Salad. A balanced gift and a balanced meal. I'll have it at my desk, for efficiency.
dlg.npc.odalys.gift.item.crop.kale.0: Kale. Nutritious and ill-tempered. I'll respect it, and offer it to Elara.
dlg.npc.odalys.gift.item.forage.snowdrop: A snowdrop. Fragile, quiet and early. I'll put it in a glass by the window.
dlg.npc.odalys.gift.item.crop.cauliflowe: Cauliflower. A plain, sensible vegetable. I approve of both qualities.
Slime. A specimen? I'll put it in a jar and label it. Then in a drawer. Far away.
dlg.npc.odalys.gift.item.resource.bone.0: A bone. Mine to keep? Fine. I'll label it. Skeleton will have a roommate.
dlg.npc.odalys.gift.item.forage.clam.0: A clam. Briny. Cold. I'll pass it to Felix with my compliments and a very wide berth.
dlg.npc.odalys.gift.cat.Fish.0: Fish. Felix's department. I'll walk it over, wash my hands twice, and prescribe myself soup.
dlg.npc.odalys.gift.repeat.0: Another one. Thank you. I'll note the pattern, in the file marked "Generous".
dlg.marcus.bark.2.0: A straight board is a happy board.
dlg.marcus.bark.3.0: The hall roof is nearly fixed.
dlg.marcus.bark.4.0: Juno labeled my chisel "Sharp (Rude)". She isn't wrong.
dlg.marcus.bark.5.0: Mind the sawdust. It gets into everything.
dlg.marcus.bark.rain.1.0: Rain tests every roof. Mine passes.
dlg.marcus.bark.storm.1.0: Checking the doors twice. A third time, quietly.
dlg.marcus.bark.wind.1.0: Wind finds every loose nail. I keep a list.
dlg.marcus.bark.spring.1.0: Spring means sheds. Everybody wants one in April.
dlg.marcus.bark.winter.1.0: Winter is for furniture. Warm hands, long grain.
dlg.marcus.bark.morning.1.0: First cut of the day is the cleanest.
dlg.marcus.bark.here.1.0: The chair by the stove is Dorian's.
dlg.marcus.bark.wed.1.0: Wednesday. Bench with Bram. Not a word.
dlg.marcus.bark.rare.1.0: I built a door that wouldn't close. Now it's a window.
dlg.marcus.bark.rare.2.0: My father's pencil is half its size. I still use it.
dlg.odalys.bark.2.0: Sleep is the best medicine and the cheapest.
dlg.odalys.bark.3.0: Wash your hands. I'll say it once more.
dlg.odalys.bark.4.0: Everyone says they feel fine. Fine is not a symptom.
dlg.odalys.bark.5.0: One bowl of soup. One hour of sunshine. Repeat.
dlg.odalys.bark.rain.1.0: Wet feet cause colds. Keep yours dry.
dlg.odalys.bark.storm.1.0: Storm. Stay in. Warm milk, if nervous.
dlg.odalys.bark.snow.1.0: Gloves on. Frostbite begins as pride.
dlg.odalys.bark.summer.1.0: Drink water. Wear a hat. This is not a suggestion.
dlg.odalys.bark.fall.1.0: Wool, hot baths and silence. Doctor's orders.
dlg.odalys.bark.morning.1.0: First patient is usually the kettle.
dlg.odalys.bark.here.1.0: The wobbly chair is yours. It's diagnostic.
dlg.odalys.bark.sat.1.0: Saturday. Clinic shut. I'm a layperson with opinions.
dlg.odalys.bark.rare.1.0: I prescribed laughter once. He filed a complaint.
dlg.odalys.bark.rare.2.0: I keep a drawer of thank-you notes. I just open it.
dlg.felix.bark.2.0: Patience is the whole trick. And bait.
dlg.felix.bark.3.0: You should've seen the other one.
dlg.felix.bark.4.0: Caught one this big. Bigger, now that I think.
dlg.felix.bark.5.0: The tide waits for no one.
dlg.felix.bark.rain.1.0: Rain's best. The fish forget to be careful.
dlg.felix.bark.storm.1.0: Storm. I tie the boat twice and talk it down.
dlg.felix.bark.snow.1.0: Snow on the pier. The gulls look offended.
dlg.felix.bark.fall.1.0: Fall runs. You can hear the fish thinking.
dlg.felix.bark.morning.1.0: Dawn's the best hour. Water's still deciding.
dlg.felix.bark.thu.1.0: Thursday. Stall's shut. I'm on the pond.
dlg.felix.bark.rare.1.0: Pulled up a boot with a clock in it. Clock was right.
dlg.felix.bark.rare.2.0: First fish I caught, I let go. It's still looking.
dlg.dorian.bark.3.0: Look under old roots. Everyone looks up.
dlg.dorian.bark.4.0: Found a mushroom shaped like a hat. Very smug.
dlg.dorian.bark.5.0: I'd rather talk to a tree.
dlg.dorian.bark.rain.1.0: Rain brings the mushrooms. Good day.
dlg.dorian.bark.storm.1.0: Storm. The forest bows. I wait under oak.
dlg.dorian.bark.snow.1.0: Snow. Every branch, a line in white.
dlg.dorian.bark.fall.1.0: Fall. Best mushrooms. Truffles hide well.
dlg.dorian.bark.morning.1.0: Dew on every web. I try not to break them.
dlg.dorian.bark.here.1.0: Step softly. The moss is listening.
dlg.dorian.bark.sat.1.0: Market. Noise. I leave a mushroom and go.
dlg.dorian.bark.rare.1.0: I argued with a stump. I lost.
dlg.dorian.bark.rare.2.0: First mushroom I found is dried in my pocket.
dlg.elara.bark.2.0: The best medicine is a good laugh. And rest.
dlg.elara.bark.3.0: I knit when it's slow. Don't tell Dr. Penn.
dlg.elara.bark.4.0: Tiny hat on the plant. Dr. Penn took it off.
dlg.elara.bark.rain.1.0: Rain means sniffles. I'll be busy!
dlg.elara.bark.storm.1.0: Thunder's the sky clearing its throat.
dlg.elara.bark.snow.1.0: Snow! Everyone's cheeks are pink. Free health check.
dlg.elara.bark.summer.1.0: Sand in the plasters. Sea air in the soul.
dlg.elara.bark.winter.1.0: This scarf is the length of a cat.
dlg.elara.bark.morning.1.0: First patient's the kettle. It's been waiting.
dlg.elara.bark.here.1.0: Not that chair. The skeleton's shy.
dlg.elara.bark.rare.1.0: I knitted a sock for a chair. It wore it proudly.
dlg.elara.bark.rare.2.0: The first person I bandaged hugged me. I'm still chasing that.
dlg.ione.bark.1.0: I set something aside for you.
dlg.ione.bark.2.0: A good book is a quiet door.
dlg.ione.bark.3.0: Overdue is a state of mind.
dlg.ione.bark.4.0: The returns box is sticky. It's decided to stay that way.
dlg.ione.bark.5.0: Everything here is older than it looks.
dlg.ione.bark.rain.1.0: Rain on the windows. The best reading weather.
dlg.ione.bark.storm.1.0: Thunder. I read aloud. The books have heard worse.
dlg.ione.bark.snow.1.0: Snow. Even the clock is tiptoeing.
dlg.ione.bark.fall.1.0: Fall. Everyone wants a long book and a short day.
dlg.ione.bark.winter.1.0: First snow's my favorite day. The books wait politely.
dlg.ione.bark.morning.1.0: The library smells of paper and possibility.
dlg.ione.bark.here.1.0: Take your time. Even the chairs are old.
dlg.ione.bark.sat.1.0: Saturday. I'm in the forest. A book without a spine.
dlg.ione.bark.rare.1.0: A bee returned a book. It left politely.
dlg.ione.bark.rare.2.0: The first book I shelved here, I still check on.
neighbours.unmet: You haven't met this neighbor yet.
neighbours.unknown_tastes: You haven't found out what {0} likes yet. Try a gift.
neighbours.hint.ready: Something is waiting. Visit {0} at home or at work.
neighbours.hint.at: There is more to learn about {0} at {1} hearts.
neighbours.hint.done: You have seen everything {0} has to show for now.
gossip.title: Gossip Book
gossip.hint: Lines you have caught that few people hear. Keep listening.
event.wren_birthday.intro: It's my birthday and nobody's allowed to look surprised. Sit. Be fabulous. Have a pickle.
event.wren_birthday.after: {if choice:bday.wren.glass}A toast, and a good one. I'll tell it for years, with improvements.{else}{if choice:bday.wren.sing}Your song's the new house anthem. Nobody asked. It's permanent.{else}A hug. Eight years in Wetherell, and that's the best gift on the shelf.{/if}{/if}
letter.wren_bday_thanks.subject: Thank you for the birthday
letter.wren_bday_thanks.body: Thank you for coming to my birthday. The pickles were a hit. The hug was, too. -- Wren
letter.wren_bday_missed.subject: A missed birthday
letter.wren_bday_missed.body: You missed my birthday. I wasn't hurt. I stood on the bar and told the stool. -- Wren
event.hazel_birthday.intro: (It's my birthday. I wasn't going to say.) Ione set out a very small cake. Please sit. Quietly.
event.hazel_birthday.after: {if choice:bday.hazel.wish}Four kind words. I wrote them in the margin of my day.{else}{if choice:bday.hazel.read}You read my favorite line. I've never heard it aloud. It sounds true.{else}Silence, shared. It's the quietest birthday I've ever had. I loved it.{/if}{/if}
letter.hazel_bday_thanks.subject: Thank you for the birthday
letter.hazel_bday_thanks.body: Thank you for coming. I kept a slice of the cake. It's still on the shelf, in your honor. -- Hazel
letter.hazel_bday_missed.subject: A missed birthday
letter.hazel_bday_missed.body: You missed my birthday. It's fine. I saved you the corner piece. It's stale. It's yours. -- Hazel
event.bram_birthday.intro: Hm. Birthday. Don't make a fuss. Juno made a card. Mostly diagrams. Hm.
event.bram_birthday.after: {if choice:bday.bram.wish}A good year. Hm. I'll aim for one. Thanks.{else}{if choice:bday.bram.gift}Hm. The gift sits on the shelf. I look at it. Good.{else}A silent birthday, on a bench. The best kind. Hm.{/if}{/if}
letter.bram_bday_thanks.subject: Thank you for the birthday
letter.bram_bday_thanks.body: Hm. Thanks for the birthday. It was good. The card's on the wall. -- Bram
letter.bram_bday_missed.subject: A missed birthday
letter.bram_bday_missed.body: Hm. You missed it. Fine. I kept the forge warm. -- Bram
event.tilda_birthday.intro: It's my birthday. I don't make a fuss, I make a large pie. Come in, dear, and do not look at the slate.
event.tilda_birthday.after: {if choice:bday.tilda.wish}Capital letters, on the slate. It looks very well from the street.{else}{if choice:bday.tilda.flower}The flower's in the window. Half the village asked who sent it. I said a friend.{else}An hour off. I read a chapter. It was marvelous. The shop was fine.{/if}{/if}
letter.tilda_bday_thanks.subject: Thank you for the birthday
letter.tilda_bday_thanks.body: Thank you for the birthday, dear. The pie's gone, the slate's full, and so am I. -- Tilda
letter.tilda_bday_missed.subject: A missed birthday
letter.tilda_bday_missed.body: You missed my birthday, dear. I saved you a slice of the pie. It's wrapped. It's on the slate. -- Tilda
event.juno_birthday.intro: Okay, okay, okay, it's my birthday and I'm not nervous! I labeled the cake. It says 'Cake (Birthday)'. Come in!
event.juno_birthday.after: {if choice:bday.juno.wish}It's in a frame, next to the first clasp that closed.{else}{if choice:bday.juno.tease}The cake label stays. Bram added a second label. It says 'Eat'.{else}A gift, on my birthday, from you. I put it on the anvil. It's the new center of everything.{/if}{/if}
letter.juno_bday_thanks.subject: Thank you for the birthday
letter.juno_bday_thanks.body: Okay, okay, okay, thank you for my birthday! The cake survived. The clasp survived. I didn't. -- Juno
letter.juno_bday_missed.subject: A missed birthday
letter.juno_bday_missed.body: You missed my birthday! I saved a slice. I labeled it 'For You (Stale)'. -- Juno
event.piper_birthday.intro: It's my birthday, and I wrote myself a song. It's a very modest masterpiece. Sit in the front row.
event.piper_birthday.after: {if choice:bday.piper.wish}It's in the encore. It rhymes with 'year', if you squint.{else}{if choice:bday.piper.sing}My song, your voice. The room clapped for you. I'm only a little jealous.{else}A song's coming, with your name in it. Don't ask when. It will rhyme.{/if}{/if}
letter.piper_bday_thanks.subject: Thank you for the birthday
letter.piper_bday_thanks.body: Thank you for coming to my birthday! The song's still stuck in my head. It's also in yours, I think. -- Piper
letter.piper_bday_missed.subject: A missed birthday
letter.piper_bday_missed.body: You missed my birthday! I played it to an empty stool. It clapped. It's very supportive. -- Piper
event.marcus_birthday.intro: It's my birthday. I planed a plank for it. Nothing fancy. A straight board. Sit on the bench.
event.marcus_birthday.after: {if choice:bday.marcus.wish}It's on the beam, in small letters. It will outlast us both.{else}{if choice:bday.marcus.plank}You noticed the plank. Nobody notices. It's hanging over the door now.{else}Two hands on a plank. A quiet, good birthday.{/if}{/if}
letter.marcus_bday_thanks.subject: Thank you for the birthday
letter.marcus_bday_thanks.body: Thank you for the birthday. The plank's on the wall. Measure twice. -- Marcus
letter.marcus_bday_missed.subject: A missed birthday
letter.marcus_bday_missed.body: You missed it. It's all right. I planed the plank anyway. It's yours. -- Marcus
event.odalys_birthday.intro: It's my birthday. I observe it with soup. If you'd like to join, sit. That is not an order. It's a gentle one.
event.odalys_birthday.after: {if choice:bday.odalys.wish}It's in the file labeled 'Unexpected'. The file is growing.{else}{if choice:bday.odalys.soup}Shared soup. I noted it as 'Successful'. Elara agrees.{else}I napped. For twenty minutes. The clinic survived.{/if}{/if}
letter.odalys_bday_thanks.subject: Thank you for the birthday
letter.odalys_bday_thanks.body: Thank you for attending my birthday. I'd call it a cure. Dr. Penn
letter.odalys_bday_missed.subject: A missed birthday
letter.odalys_bday_missed.body: You missed my birthday. I was unwell with disappointment. It's passed. -- Dr. Penn
event.felix_birthday.intro: It's my birthday. I'd be fishing, but Tilda says I mustn't. She brought a pie. I brought a story. It's about a fish.
event.felix_birthday.after: {if choice:bday.felix.wish}The fish know. They're pretending they don't.{else}{if choice:bday.felix.story}The story's longer now. I added a hand. You were in it.{else}Dawn, the pond, and two lines. A fine birthday present.{/if}{/if}
letter.felix_bday_thanks.subject: Thank you for the birthday
letter.felix_bday_thanks.body: Thank you for the birthday. The pie's gone. The fish got the crumbs. -- Felix
letter.felix_bday_missed.subject: A missed birthday
letter.felix_bday_missed.body: You missed my birthday. I fished alone. I caught one this big. It was no help. -- Felix
event.dorian_birthday.intro: ...It's my birthday. I didn't say. Marcus said. I'd rather be in the forest. Stay a minute. Not long.
event.dorian_birthday.after: {if choice:bday.dorian.wish}Quiet words. I kept them.{else}{if choice:bday.dorian.walk}We walked, we said little. It was a good birthday.{else}The pinecone's on my shelf. It's the best one. Not me. You.{/if}{/if}
letter.dorian_bday_thanks.subject: Thank you for the birthday
letter.dorian_bday_thanks.body: Thank you for the birthday. It was quiet. It was good. -- D.
letter.dorian_bday_missed.subject: A missed birthday
letter.dorian_bday_missed.body: You missed it. It's fine. I walked alone. The trees said happy birthday. -- D.
event.elara_birthday.intro: It's my birthday! I knitted myself a hat to celebrate! It has a very small hat on it! Come in, come in!
event.elara_birthday.after: {if choice:bday.elara.wish}It's in the scarf, row nine hundred, in red.{else}{if choice:bday.elara.hat}The hat on the hat stays. Dr. Penn pretended not to see it. She smiled.{else}The beach was perfect. I'm still sandy. I love it.{/if}{/if}
letter.elara_bday_thanks.subject: Thank you for the birthday
letter.elara_bday_thanks.body: Thank you for coming to my birthday! The hat's a hit. The sandwich is gone. -- Elara
letter.elara_bday_missed.subject: A missed birthday
letter.elara_bday_missed.body: You missed my birthday! I saved a sock for you. It's for later. It's always a sock. -- Elara
event.ione_birthday.intro: It's my birthday. I don't make a fuss. I read a new book on the day. Come in. I set something aside for you.
event.ione_birthday.after: {if choice:bday.ione.wish}It's set aside, between two good pages. I'll find it often.{else}{if choice:bday.ione.read}Your voice, my library. The books were listening. They're quiet about it.{else}The bookmark's in the favorite. It's holding a very good place.{/if}{/if}
letter.ione_bday_thanks.subject: Thank you for the birthday
letter.ione_bday_thanks.body: Thank you for coming to my birthday. I read the first page of your book. It was lovely. -- Ione
letter.ione_bday_missed.subject: A missed birthday
letter.ione_bday_missed.body: You missed my birthday. I set a book aside for you. It's on the desk. -- Ione
dlg.wren.birthday.r0: To me! Oh, the best toast I've had all year, and I wrote the other ones.
dlg.wren.birthday.r1: That was dreadful. Do it again. Louder. The stool is crying.
dlg.wren.birthday.r2: Oh. ...Oh, you're a menace. A kind one. Sit down before I embarrass us both.
dlg.hazel.birthday.r0: Thank you. (That's four words, said kindly.) I'll keep them.
dlg.hazel.birthday.r1: That one. (You remembered.) I may need a moment.
dlg.hazel.birthday.r2: ...Yes. This. (The best present.) Please stay a while.
dlg.bram.birthday.r0: Hm. Good year. I'll try. Thank you.
dlg.bram.birthday.r1: ...Hm. For me? Hm. It's a good one. Thank you.
dlg.bram.birthday.r2: Hm. Good. That's all I want. Sit.
dlg.tilda.birthday.r0: Thank you. I'll put it on the slate in capital letters, where I can see it.
dlg.tilda.birthday.r1: A flower, in my shop! It goes in the window, beside the good pumpkin. Thank you.
dlg.tilda.birthday.r2: You'd mind it? Oh, that's the best present. Take the stool. Mind the cat.
dlg.juno.birthday.r0: Thank you! I'm having it framed. Don't tell Bram.
dlg.juno.birthday.r1: It's a perfectly good label! ...Okay, it's too good. I'm blushing.
dlg.juno.birthday.r2: A gift! For me! I'm going to cry on a clasp. Thank you!
dlg.piper.birthday.r0: That's a chorus! Thank you. I'll use it in the encore.
dlg.piper.birthday.r1: You sang my song! Badly! Perfectly! I'm stealing your key.
dlg.piper.birthday.r2: The next one's for you. It's not finished. It will be a birthday present, on a late schedule.
dlg.marcus.birthday.r0: Thank you. I'll note it on the beam. Measure twice, thank twice.
dlg.marcus.birthday.r1: It's a good one. Oak. Straight grain. Thank you for noticing.
dlg.marcus.birthday.r2: The other end. Yes. That's the best birthday present: a second pair of hands.
dlg.odalys.birthday.r0: Thank you. I'll file it under 'Unexpected, pleasant'.
dlg.odalys.birthday.r1: Soup, shared. A treatment with no side effects. Thank you.
dlg.odalys.birthday.r2: A nap. As prescribed. ...I'll follow your orders. Rarely done, never regretted.
dlg.felix.birthday.r0: Thank you. I'll tell the fish. They'll be unmoved, but I'll feel better.
dlg.felix.birthday.r1: It was this big. Bigger, since I began. Thank you for listening.
dlg.felix.birthday.r2: Dawn tomorrow. Bring a line. I'll bring the good rock.
dlg.dorian.birthday.r1: A walk. Yes. Slowly. I'll show you a quiet spot.
dlg.dorian.birthday.r2: A pinecone. From you. ...It's the best one. I'm keeping it.
dlg.elara.birthday.r0: Thank you! I'll knit it into a scarf!
dlg.elara.birthday.r1: It's a hat with a hat! You understand! I'm so happy I might cry!
dlg.elara.birthday.r2: The beach! On my birthday! Yes! I'll pack a sandwich and a very long scarf!
dlg.ione.birthday.r0: Thank you. I'll set it aside, between two good pages.
dlg.ione.birthday.r1: You read aloud. It's been years. Please go slowly. It's lovely.
dlg.ione.birthday.r2: A bookmark. From you. It's going in my favorite book, right now.
dlg.hazel.birthday.c1: Read her a line from her favorite book.
dlg.bram.birthday.c2: Sit on the bench with him.
dlg.tilda.birthday.c2: Offer to mind the shop for an hour.
dlg.juno.birthday.c1: Tease her about the cake label.
dlg.marcus.birthday.c2: Offer to hold the other end.
dlg.dorian.birthday.c1: Offer a walk in the forest.
dlg.elara.birthday.c2: Offer her a day at the beach.
event.wren_courtship.intro: Sit. I've rehearsed this in the mirror, in the cellar and once to a pickle. I like you. More than the pickle. Quite a lot more.
event.wren_courtship.after: {if flag:choice.courtship.wren.yes}Walks, then. And poems. You're stuck with me, and I'm stuck with the stool.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.wren.friends}The best of friends. It's written on the slate in my head, in capital letters.{else}Whenever you like. I'll be on the stage, being patient. It's a new look.{/if}{/if}
event.wren_courtship2.intro: Sit. I've rehearsed this in the mirror, in the cellar and once to a pickle. I like you. More than the pickle. Quite a lot more.
event.wren_courtship2.after: {if flag:choice.courtship.wren.yes}Walks, then. And poems. You're stuck with me, and I'm stuck with the stool.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.wren.friends}The best of friends. It's written on the slate in my head, in capital letters.{else}Whenever you like. I'll be on the stage, being patient. It's a new look.{/if}{/if}
event.wren_partners.intro: Evening, my darling pickle-eater. I wrote you a song. It's rubbish. It's mine. Sit and be sung at.
event.wren_partners.after: {if choice:courtship.wren.song}The song's finished now. It has your name in the second verse and an extra chorus.{else}{if choice:courtship.wren.dance}We danced. Nobody looked. Everybody looked. I loved it.{else}The bag under my bed is empty. I unpacked it this morning. You were the reason, quietly.{/if}{/if}
event.hazel_courtship.intro: (I've drafted this in four versions.) May I ask something? Plainly. (Would you like to court me?) I didn't plan the last word.
event.hazel_courtship.after: {if flag:choice.courtship.hazel.yes}A courtship, then. (A slow one.) I'll start by saving you the good chair.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.hazel.friends}Friends. (The best kind of margin note.) I'm glad. I'm also a little sad, politely.{else}Take all the time. (The shelf will keep your place.) Come back whenever.{/if}{/if}
event.hazel_courtship2.intro: (I've drafted this in four versions.) May I ask something? Plainly. (Would you like to court me?) I didn't plan the last word.
event.hazel_courtship2.after: {if flag:choice.courtship.hazel.yes}A courtship, then. (A slow one.) I'll start by saving you the good chair.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.hazel.friends}Friends. (The best kind of margin note.) I'm glad. I'm also a little sad, politely.{else}Take all the time. (The shelf will keep your place.) Come back whenever.{/if}{/if}
event.hazel_partners.intro: (I wrote you something.) It's not a book. It's a page. A single page. Please sit. Read it with me.
event.hazel_partners.after: {if choice:courtship.hazel.read}The page is pinned above the desk. It has your name at the bottom. In pencil, so it can be amended.{else}{if choice:courtship.hazel.hand}Your hand and my hand, over the desk. (I may reread it for years.){else}The forest was loud. You were quiet. It was the right balance.{/if}{/if}
event.juno_courtship.intro: Okay, okay, okay. I made a list. 'Reasons I like the farmer.' It has forty items. I'd read them but I'll faint. So. Would you court me?
event.juno_courtship.after: {if flag:choice.courtship.juno.yes}Courting! Bram says I'm vibrating. I am! Thank you!{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.juno.friends}Friends, forever, labeled. It's on the shelf. Next to the first clasp.{else}Take your time. I'll finish item forty-one. It's 'patient'.{/if}{/if}
event.juno_courtship2.intro: Okay, okay, okay. I made a list. 'Reasons I like the farmer.' It has forty items. I'd read them but I'll faint. So. Would you court me?
event.juno_courtship2.after: {if flag:choice.courtship.juno.yes}Courting! Bram says I'm vibrating. I am! Thank you!{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.juno.friends}Friends, forever, labeled. It's on the shelf. Next to the first clasp.{else}Take your time. I'll finish item forty-one. It's 'patient'.{/if}{/if}
event.juno_partners.intro: Hi! Hi, hi! I made you something. It took four hours and I'm not nervous. It's a tiny anvil. For your desk. It doesn't do anything!
event.juno_partners.after: {if choice:courtship.juno.anvil}The tiny anvil is on my bench. It's the most important tool I own. It doesn't do anything.{else}{if choice:courtship.juno.beach}The beach was perfect. I got sand in a clasp. I'm keeping it. It's a souvenir.{else}Hands, in the forge. Bram pretended not to see. He smiled. I saw.{/if}{/if}
event.piper_courtship.intro: So. I've written a love song and a coward's song. This is the coward's. Would you court me? It scans if you say yes.
event.piper_courtship.after: {if flag:choice.courtship.piper.yes}A love song, rhymed and bridged. You'll hear it Friday. It's unbearable. You'll love it.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.piper.friends}Friends. A great duet. We'll get a spotlight and a better stool.{else}A verse or two, and a bridge. Take your time. I'll hum while I wait.{/if}{/if}
event.piper_courtship2.intro: So. I've written a love song and a coward's song. This is the coward's. Would you court me? It scans if you say yes.
event.piper_courtship2.after: {if flag:choice.courtship.piper.yes}A love song, rhymed and bridged. You'll hear it Friday. It's unbearable. You'll love it.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.piper.friends}Friends. A great duet. We'll get a spotlight and a better stool.{else}A verse or two, and a bridge. Take your time. I'll hum while I wait.{/if}{/if}
event.piper_partners.intro: Hey, you. Front row. I wrote a song for you and it's the first one I haven't hidden. Please clap anyway. Gently.
event.piper_partners.after: {if choice:courtship.piper.song}The song has your name in the bridge. The bridge is the best part. It's yours.{else}{if choice:courtship.piper.duet}We sang the chorus together. The room joined in. I almost forgot the bridge.{else}A walk home under the stars. I hummed. You hummed back. The best accompaniment.{/if}{/if}
event.felix_courtship.intro: Hm. Right. I've caught bigger things than my nerve. Here goes. Would you court me? Slowly. Like a good lure.
event.felix_courtship.after: {if flag:choice.courtship.felix.yes}Dawn, the pond, and two lines. I'll bring the thermos. You bring the stories.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.felix.friends}Friends, then. The finest bait, and no hooks. I'll keep the invitation open.{else}Time, then. The pond's patient. So am I. Mostly.{/if}{/if}
event.felix_courtship2.intro: Hm. Right. I've caught bigger things than my nerve. Here goes. Would you court me? Slowly. Like a good lure.
event.felix_courtship2.after: {if flag:choice.courtship.felix.yes}Dawn, the pond, and two lines. I'll bring the thermos. You bring the stories.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.felix.friends}Friends, then. The finest bait, and no hooks. I'll keep the invitation open.{else}Time, then. The pond's patient. So am I. Mostly.{/if}{/if}
event.felix_partners.intro: Morning. I caught something. It's for you. It isn't a fish. It's a shell. A very good one. Sit. Hold it up to your ear.
event.felix_partners.after: {if choice:courtship.felix.shell}The shell sits on my shelf, next to the best hook. It still says your name. Or 'hello'.{else}{if choice:courtship.felix.fish}Dawn, two lines, one very small fish. It was the best catch in years. We threw it back.{else}The sunrise was quiet. So were we. It was the longest sentence I've ever said.{/if}{/if}
event.dorian_courtship.intro: ...I've been quiet a long time. I'd like to say one thing, and not take it back. Would you court me? Slowly. In the forest. Quietly.
event.dorian_courtship.after: {if flag:choice.courtship.dorian.yes}A walk, tomorrow. No talking until the third tree. After that, maybe.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.dorian.friends}Friends. That's a good word. I'll keep it, in a quiet place.{else}Take the time. I'll be in the forest. Not hiding. Waiting.{/if}{/if}
event.dorian_courtship2.intro: ...I've been quiet a long time. I'd like to say one thing, and not take it back. Would you court me? Slowly. In the forest. Quietly.
event.dorian_courtship2.after: {if flag:choice.courtship.dorian.yes}A walk, tomorrow. No talking until the third tree. After that, maybe.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.dorian.friends}Friends. That's a good word. I'll keep it, in a quiet place.{else}Take the time. I'll be in the forest. Not hiding. Waiting.{/if}{/if}
event.dorian_partners.intro: ...I made something. It isn't much. A feather, a stick, and a bit of twine. It's for you. Sit. Hold it.
event.dorian_partners.after: {if choice:courtship.dorian.feather}The feather's on my shelf. Next to the pinecone. They're a set. You're the third.{else}{if choice:courtship.dorian.walk}We walked until the light went amber. I said six words. They were all good.{else}A quiet hour, beside you. It's the best thing I own. Don't tell the trees.{/if}{/if}
event.elara_courtship.intro: I knitted a very long scarf and the last row is a question! Would you court me? It's red, so it's very serious!
event.elara_courtship.after: {if flag:choice.courtship.elara.yes}Courting! The scarf is yours! We'll wear it together! It's long enough! I measured!{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.elara.friends}Friends, forever. I'll knit it into the next row. In blue, so it's calm.{else}Take your time. The scarf will keep. I'll add a row a day. It's a ritual.{/if}{/if}
event.elara_courtship2.intro: I knitted a very long scarf and the last row is a question! Would you court me? It's red, so it's very serious!
event.elara_courtship2.after: {if flag:choice.courtship.elara.yes}Courting! The scarf is yours! We'll wear it together! It's long enough! I measured!{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.elara.friends}Friends, forever. I'll knit it into the next row. In blue, so it's calm.{else}Take your time. The scarf will keep. I'll add a row a day. It's a ritual.{/if}{/if}
event.elara_partners.intro: Hello! I made you something! It's a hat! It has a smaller hat on it! The smaller hat has a tiniest hat! It's hats all the way down!
event.elara_partners.after: {if choice:courtship.elara.hat}The hat stays on my shelf. The smaller hat stays on it. We're all very close.{else}{if choice:courtship.elara.knit}Our row is the middle of the scarf. It's slightly crooked. It's the best part.{else}The sunset was pink. So was I. I wore the red scarf. It matched.{/if}{/if}
event.ione_courtship.intro: I've read a great many love stories, and none of them told me how to say this. Would you court me? That's a plain question. I rewrote it eleven times.
event.ione_courtship.after: {if flag:choice.courtship.ione.yes}A courtship, then. I'll start by reading you the first page of a new book. Aloud.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.ione.friends}Friends. A wonderful shelf to share. I'll keep the invitation between two pages.{else}Take all the time you need. The library will keep your place.{/if}{/if}
event.ione_courtship2.intro: I've read a great many love stories, and none of them told me how to say this. Would you court me? That's a plain question. I rewrote it eleven times.
event.ione_courtship2.after: {if flag:choice.courtship.ione.yes}A courtship, then. I'll start by reading you the first page of a new book. Aloud.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.ione.friends}Friends. A wonderful shelf to share. I'll keep the invitation between two pages.{else}Take all the time you need. The library will keep your place.{/if}{/if}
event.ione_partners.intro: Come in. I wrote you a letter. It's longer than I meant. Sit, please. I'll read it, and you'll pretend not to blush.
event.ione_partners.after: {if choice:courtship.ione.letter}The letter's in my favorite book. It marks the best page. It's yours.{else}{if choice:courtship.ione.read}Your voice, my library. The books are very quiet about it. I think they approve.{else}The shore was bright. I forgot the book entirely. It's a small, wonderful betrayal.{/if}{/if}
dlg.wren.partners.talk0.0: Good morning, you. I woke up with the chorus in my head. It was yours.
dlg.wren.partners.talk1.0: Come sit. The stool's warm. I warmed it. For you.
dlg.wren.partners.talk2.0: Every night, one verse. By winter we'll have an album, and no one's allowed to review it.
dlg.hazel.partners.talk0.0: (You came.) The chair is yours. It's always yours now. I labeled it.
dlg.hazel.partners.talk1.0: I put a bookmark in the day. It's for later, with you.
dlg.hazel.partners.talk2.0: Come, sit. (I'll read, you listen, and we'll both pretend it's about the book.)
dlg.juno.partners.talk0.0: Good morning, hi! I made a tea. I didn't label it. That's how you know it's serious.
dlg.juno.partners.talk1.0: Come here, come here. I want to show you a tiny hinge. It's the best thing today. Second best.
dlg.juno.partners.talk2.0: Forty items on the list, and now it's forty-one. The new one's 'This'.
dlg.piper.partners.talk0.0: Hi, you. I woke up humming. It was about you. It's always about you now. It's a problem. It's lovely.
dlg.piper.partners.talk1.0: Come to the front row. I'll save you the best seat. It's the one by the speaker.
dlg.piper.partners.talk2.0: Every night, a new line. By spring we'll have a whole musical. It'll be dreadful and perfect.
dlg.felix.partners.talk0.0: Morning. I saved you the good rock. It's warm. I warmed it. Sit.
dlg.felix.partners.talk1.0: I caught one this big. Bigger. I'll tell you later. Slowly. With your hand in mine.
dlg.felix.partners.talk2.0: Every dawn, two lines. By winter we'll have the pond figured out. Or we won't. That's fine, too.
dlg.dorian.partners.talk0.0: ...Morning. The oak asked about you. I said you were well. It was pleased.
dlg.dorian.partners.talk1.0: Come. I found a clearing. It's small. It's ours.
dlg.dorian.partners.talk2.0: I used to love the quiet because it was empty. Now I love it because it's yours too.
dlg.elara.partners.talk0.0: Good morning! I knitted a sock! It's for you! It's the left one! The right one's tomorrow!
dlg.elara.partners.talk1.0: Come in, come in! I saved you a spot on the couch! It has a blanket! I made the blanket!
dlg.elara.partners.talk2.0: A row a day, with you! By winter we'll have a scarf that reaches the beach! I measured!
dlg.ione.partners.talk0.0: Good morning. I set aside a chair by the window. It has a cushion. It's yours.
dlg.ione.partners.talk1.0: Come, sit. I'll read, you rest. The books won't mind. They think you're one of us.
dlg.ione.partners.talk2.0: Every evening, a chapter. By winter we'll be at the end. I'll write a second book, just so we don't stop.
dlg.wren.courtship.r0: Court. Oh. Yes. Properly, with walks and terrible poems. I'll write the first one tonight and burn it.
dlg.wren.courtship.r1: Friends. Yes. The best kind, I'd say. Nothing changes and everything stays. I'm relieved, and a little proud.
dlg.wren.courtship.r2: Wait. Fair. I've waited eight years for a decent stool. I can wait for the right moment.
dlg.wren.partners.0: How shall we spend the evening?
dlg.wren.partners.r0: Every verse! Oh, you angel. I'll sing the bridge twice, because it's my favorite.
dlg.wren.partners.r1: Dance! In the saloon! The floor's sticky and I don't care. Hold on.
dlg.wren.partners.r2: A walk home. Past the bakery, past the lamp, past all my old excuses. Lead on.
dlg.hazel.courtship.r0: (Yes.) That's the whole sentence. Yes. I'll write the rest later. Please stay a while.
dlg.hazel.courtship.r1: (Friends.) A good word. A full chapter. Thank you for saying it kindly.
dlg.hazel.courtship.r2: (Time.) Of course. Books wait. So can I. Quietly, at the desk.
dlg.hazel.partners.0: How shall we spend the evening?
dlg.hazel.partners.r0: (We read it aloud.) It sounds truer in two voices. That's a sentence I'll keep.
dlg.hazel.partners.r1: (Oh.) Your hand is warm. Mine is ink-stained. They match. Stay a while.
dlg.hazel.partners.r2: The forest. With you. (The birds will be loud.) Let them be. I'll listen to you instead.
dlg.juno.courtship.r0: YES. Okay. Oh my gosh. I'm going to need a minute and also a hammer. Courting! With you!
dlg.juno.courtship.r1: Friends! Oh, okay! Good! Great! The best! ...I'll label this one 'Friends (Very Good)'. Thank you for saying it honestly.
dlg.juno.courtship.r2: Think! Yes! Take your time! I'll be right here, polishing a clasp, not looking at the door.
dlg.juno.partners.0: How shall we spend the evening?
dlg.juno.partners.r0: It's perfect, right? It's tiny! It rings if you hit it with a pin. I tested it. Twice. Once on Bram.
dlg.juno.partners.r1: The beach! With sand! I'll bring a clasp for luck. And a sandwich. Not for the clasp.
dlg.juno.partners.r2: Okay. Yes. Hands. I'm very warm, it's the forge, definitely. Don't let go.
dlg.piper.courtship.r0: Yes! The love song's for you. It rhymes! It has a bridge! I'm going to be insufferable.
dlg.piper.courtship.r1: Friends. That's a good chorus, too. I'll sing it with feeling. Thank you for the honest note.
dlg.piper.courtship.r2: A verse or two. Fair. It's a long song. I'll leave the last line unwritten.
dlg.piper.partners.0: How shall we spend the evening?
dlg.piper.partners.r0: Every note. Oh, you star. I might tear up on the high part, and I'll blame the stage lights.
dlg.piper.partners.r1: A duet! You know the words! ...You know the words. I wrote them yesterday. You're a wonder.
dlg.piper.partners.r2: A walk after the set. The night's quiet. I'm loud. Let's see who wins.
dlg.felix.courtship.r0: Yes! Oh, the best catch of my life, and I wasn't even trying. Dawn tomorrow, two lines, and the good rock.
dlg.felix.courtship.r1: Friends. A fine thing. The best fishing partners are friends. I'm happy. I'm also a little quiet. Thank you.
dlg.felix.courtship.r2: A little time. Good. Fish take time. So can the rest of it.
dlg.felix.partners.0: How shall we spend the evening?
dlg.felix.partners.r0: Hear it? That's the sea. It's saying something. I think it's saying your name. It could be 'hello'.
dlg.felix.partners.r1: Dawn, two lines, and the good rock. You hold one. I'll hold the thermos. It's the finest morning.
dlg.felix.partners.r2: The sun comes up. We don't say much. The fish don't mind. It's perfect.
dlg.dorian.courtship.r0: ...Yes. I wasn't sure you'd say it. I'll show you the quiet places. All of them. Slowly.
dlg.dorian.courtship.r1: Friends. ...Good. That's a lot, for me. Thank you for saying it kindly.
dlg.dorian.courtship.r2: Wait. Yes. I'm good at waiting. The trees taught me.
dlg.dorian.partners.0: How shall we spend the evening?
dlg.dorian.partners.r0: ...It's small. It's soft. It's yours. I found it the day I met you. I kept it for later.
dlg.dorian.partners.r1: The forest, with you. I'll show you the oak. It's old. It's quiet. It's the best listener I know.
dlg.dorian.partners.r2: ...Yes. This. Sit. We don't need words. We never did. Thank you.
dlg.elara.courtship.r0: YES! Oh, I'm so happy my yarn is shaking! The scarf is yours! The whole nine yards! Literally! I measured!
dlg.elara.courtship.r1: Friends! The best! Truly! I'll knit a friend-sized scarf! It's like a regular one but with more feelings! Thank you for saying it kindly!
dlg.elara.courtship.r2: Think! Take a long time! I'll add rows! The scarf will grow! It's fine!
dlg.elara.partners.0: How shall we spend the evening?
dlg.elara.partners.r0: You look so good! The tiniest hat is slightly crooked! It's perfect! I'm crying a little!
dlg.elara.partners.r1: Together! Hold the needle! No, the other end! There! We made a row! It's the best row!
dlg.elara.partners.r2: The beach at sunset! I'll bring a blanket and three snacks! The snacks are for you. The blanket is for us!
dlg.ione.courtship.r0: Yes. ...Oh, good. I'll set aside a shelf for the two of us. A small one, near the window.
dlg.ione.courtship.r1: Friends. A lovely thing to be. The best stories begin there. Thank you for saying it so kindly.
dlg.ione.courtship.r2: Wait. Of course. A good book isn't rushed. Neither is this.
dlg.ione.partners.0: How shall we spend the evening?
dlg.ione.partners.r0: Every word. Thank you. ...I'm blushing, and I'm the one who wrote it.
dlg.ione.partners.r1: You read aloud, and the books lean in. They've missed being listened to. So have I.
dlg.ione.partners.r2: The shore. With you. I'll bring a book and not open it. That's a first.
dlg.wren.courtship.c1: Let's stay the best of friends.
dlg.wren.partners.c1: Dance with her between the tables.
dlg.wren.partners.c2: Walk her home under the stars.
dlg.hazel.courtship.c0: Yes. I'd like that very much.
dlg.hazel.partners.c1: Hold her hand over the desk.
dlg.juno.courtship.c0: Yes! Forty items is a lot.
dlg.juno.partners.c2: Hold her hand at the forge.
dlg.piper.courtship.c0: Yes. Sing me the love song.
dlg.piper.courtship.c2: Give me a verse or two.
dlg.piper.partners.c2: Walk her home after the set.
dlg.elara.courtship.c0: Yes! Show me the whole scarf.
dlg.ione.partners.c1: Read to her in the stacks.
event.overheard_juno_bram_1.l1: Bram! I labeled the tongs. 'Tongs (Left)'. 'Tongs (Right)'. They're the same tongs.
event.overheard_juno_bram_1.l2: Hm. They've always known which is which.
event.overheard_juno_bram_1.l3: That's what the labels are for! So everyone knows!
event.overheard_juno_bram_1.l4: Hm. Everyone knows. Take the label off my hat.
event.overheard_juno_bram_2.l1: Bram. Did you add a label to my cake? It says 'Eat'.
event.overheard_juno_bram_2.l2: Hm. It was missing a verb.
event.overheard_juno_bram_2.l3: It's the nicest label anyone's made me, and I made the labels!
event.overheard_juno_bram_2.l4: Hm. Don't cry on the clasp. It'll rust.
event.overheard_juno_bram_3.l1: Bram! I'm on your bench again, and I carved a small mistake into it. Don't look.
event.overheard_juno_bram_3.l2: Hm. Saw it. Best joint in the shop. Don't change it.
event.overheard_juno_bram_3.l3: Wait. Was that a compliment? Bram, was that a compliment? I need a minute.
event.overheard_juno_bram_3.l4: Hm. Take the minute. Move over.
event.overheard_hazel_ione_1.l1: (Third shelf, left. The mystery is back in order.)
event.overheard_hazel_ione_1.l2: Thank you. The silence in here is yours, you know. I only sweep it.
event.overheard_hazel_ione_1.l4: Agreed. Now, pour the tea, quietly, and nobody has to say another word.
event.overheard_hazel_ione_2.l1: There's a book on the desk that's seven years overdue. It's yours.
event.overheard_hazel_ione_2.l2: (It's a very long book.) (I'm on the last chapter.)
event.overheard_hazel_ione_2.l3: You're on a chapter every year, then?
event.overheard_hazel_ione_2.l4: (It's a very slow chapter.) (I'm enjoying it.)
event.overheard_hazel_ione_3.l1: I left a chair by the window. It has a cushion. It's for whoever needs it.
event.overheard_hazel_ione_3.l2: (It's for me. Yes? Thank you.) (I won't say so aloud.)
event.overheard_hazel_ione_3.l3: You've said it in four words. It's plenty. Sit. The window's warm.
event.overheard_elara_odalys_1.l1: Dr. Penn! I knitted the waiting room a cozy! It goes on the stool! The stool's very proud!
event.overheard_elara_odalys_1.l2: Elara. A stool does not have pride. ...It looks well on it. Leave it.
event.overheard_elara_odalys_1.l3: I knew it! A cozy for the stool, and a smaller cozy for the cozy!
event.overheard_elara_odalys_1.l4: No. Stop there. That is a medical instruction.
event.overheard_elara_odalys_2.l1: I made soup for the whole clinic! It has seven kinds of vegetable! One of them is a surprise!
event.overheard_elara_odalys_2.l2: Elara. I accept the soup. I do not accept the surprise. Which one is it?
event.overheard_elara_odalys_2.l3: It's a turnip! It's wearing a carrot costume! It's very brave!
event.overheard_elara_odalys_2.l4: ...Hm. It's the best soup I've had. Pass the bowl. Quietly.
event.overheard_elara_odalys_3.l1: Dr. Penn, you've worked eleven hours. I knitted you a sleeping mask! It's lavender!
event.overheard_elara_odalys_3.l2: Elara. ...It's soft. I'll try it for ten minutes. That is generous.
event.overheard_elara_odalys_3.l3: Ten minutes is a perfect nap! I'll cover the desk! I'll answer nothing, kindly!
event.overheard_elara_odalys_3.l4: Thank you. Keep the lamp low. And, Elara. This was good care.
event.overheard_marcus_dorian_1.l1: Dorian. Hold the end. No, the other end. There.
event.overheard_marcus_dorian_1.l3: Straight. That's the whole job. I couldn't have said it better.
event.overheard_marcus_dorian_2.l1: It's been an hour. You haven't said anything.
event.overheard_marcus_dorian_2.l3: I was getting worried. No, I wasn't. I was enjoying it.
event.overheard_marcus_dorian_3.l1: I made a door for your forest hut. It's oak. It's heavier than it looks.
event.overheard_marcus_dorian_3.l2: ...It's good. It's the first door I've owned that I'd close on purpose.
event.overheard_marcus_dorian_3.l3: That's the whole idea of a door.
event.overheard_marcus_dorian_3.l4: ...Thank you. It's a very good door. I'll keep it open. Mostly.
event.overheard_wren_piper_1.l1: You're flat on the third bar, my darling. Fabulously flat. Do it again.
event.overheard_wren_piper_1.l2: I'm not flat, the stool's tilted! It's a stage stool, Wren, it has opinions!
event.overheard_wren_piper_1.l3: The stool doesn't have opinions. I do. Again. From the top.
event.overheard_wren_piper_1.l4: Fine, fine, from the top. But I'm taking the bridge up a key out of spite.
event.overheard_wren_piper_2.l1: I wrote a verse. It's for the saloon. It's about you, and I'm sorry.
event.overheard_wren_piper_2.l2: Wren! You wrote a verse? Read it! Read it! No, wait. Sing it. Sing it badly. I'll fix it.
event.overheard_wren_piper_2.l3: 'Piper sings and the rafters shake, and every glass in town awake.' That's all I've got.
event.overheard_wren_piper_2.l4: It's perfect. I'm stealing it. It's the opening of my next song, and you're getting credit in tiny letters.
event.overheard_wren_piper_3.l1: Last song, Piper. The room's tired. So am I. Make it a soft one.
event.overheard_wren_piper_3.l2: Soft, I can do. I'll hum. No words. Just you and the stool and the lamplight.
event.overheard_wren_piper_3.l3: My darling, that's the best verse you've written. Don't write it down.
event.overheard_wren_piper_3.l4: I won't. It'll live in the room. Pass me the last glass.
event.overheard_tilda_felix_1.l1: Felix, dear. Your carp is eight coins. Last week it was six.
event.overheard_tilda_felix_1.l2: It's a bigger carp. It's grown. It's grown in the stall, overnight, out of pride.
event.overheard_tilda_felix_1.l3: Dear, it's been in your bucket since dawn. It hasn't grown. You've inflated it.
event.overheard_tilda_felix_1.l4: Fine. Six. But I'm adding a story to the price. It's a good story.
event.overheard_tilda_felix_2.l1: Tilda. You remember the winter the pond froze, and I fell in?
event.overheard_tilda_felix_2.l2: Dear, I remember the winter you fell in, and also the winter you fell in again.
event.overheard_tilda_felix_2.l3: It was the same winter. It was a long one. You brought me soup.
event.overheard_tilda_felix_2.l4: I brought you soup, and a blanket, and I labeled the pond 'Do Not Enter'. You ignored the label.
event.overheard_tilda_felix_3.l1: Tilda. I wrote the first fish of the year on your slate. In capital letters.
event.overheard_tilda_felix_3.l2: Oh, Felix. It's a very good fish. I'll leave it up until the spring thaw.
event.overheard_tilda_felix_3.l3: It was this big. Bigger, since I began. Don't tell the pond.
event.overheard_tilda_felix_3.l4: The pond knows, dear. The pond always knows. Sit. I'll put the kettle on.
dlg.wren.festival.spring.before.0: Tomorrow's Blossom Day. I'm tuning the saloon's good stool for the dance. It's emotional.
dlg.wren.festival.spring.day.0: Blossom Day! I'm running the cider table, so everyone's my friend. Have a cup. Dance badly. I'm judging.
dlg.wren.festival.spring.after.0: Last night's dance is in the floorboards. I'll sweep it up tomorrow. Today I'm sentimental.
dlg.wren.festival.summer.before.0: The Tidewatch is tomorrow. I'm taking bets. Not money. Pickles. Pickles are the real currency.
dlg.wren.festival.summer.day.0: I'm the Tidewatch's official heckler. Cheer loudly, my darling. Felix needs it, and I need the material.
dlg.wren.festival.summer.after.0: Felix lost on purpose, and I won the pickle pool. A very clean afternoon, morally speaking.
dlg.wren.festival.fall.before.0: Harvest Fair tomorrow. I'm judging the pickles. It's an honor. I've been practicing my face.
dlg.wren.festival.fall.day.0: I judge the preserves today. Be nice to your jam. I can taste fear.
dlg.wren.festival.fall.after.0: The pickle judging's over. I cried at a gherkin. Please tell nobody.
dlg.wren.festival.winter.before.0: Lantern Feast tomorrow. I'm writing a toast. It has three jokes and one real sentence.
dlg.wren.festival.winter.day.0: I give the toast tonight. Three jokes, one real sentence. Guess which one you'll remember.
dlg.wren.festival.winter.after.0: The toast went well. The real sentence landed. I'm pretending I meant it as a joke.
dlg.hazel.festival.spring.before.0: (Tomorrow, Blossom Day.) (I'm to carry the garlands.) (They're lighter than books. Barely.)
dlg.hazel.festival.spring.day.0: (Blossom Day.) (The garlands are hung.) Come along, quietly, to the square. (I'll stand near the edge.)
dlg.hazel.festival.spring.after.0: (The blossoms are on the floor now.) A few came into the library. (I'm keeping one as a bookmark.)
dlg.hazel.festival.summer.before.0: The Tidewatch is tomorrow. (A beach. A crowd.) Sand will find the books. Please be kind to the spines.
dlg.hazel.festival.summer.day.0: (The Tidewatch.) (I brought a blanket and a book. Both are damp.) The tide is rather good, though.
dlg.hazel.festival.summer.after.0: (Sand in the stacks again.) A small price. (Felix waved at me. I waved back, once.)
dlg.hazel.festival.fall.before.0: The Harvest Fair is tomorrow. Ione wants the ribbon names read aloud. (Quietly, I hope.)
dlg.hazel.festival.fall.day.0: The Harvest Fair. The ribbon names are read, in order, to a crowd. (Better than the rehearsal.)
dlg.hazel.festival.fall.after.0: (Ribbons, and a long day.) The library feels very quiet now. (It's a good quiet.)
dlg.hazel.festival.winter.before.0: The Lantern Feast is tomorrow. A small poem sits on my lantern. Please don't read it. (Read it a little.)
dlg.hazel.festival.winter.day.0: The Lantern Feast. My lantern is the blue one, third from the left. The poem is short. (It's about a library, and you.)
dlg.hazel.festival.winter.after.0: (The lanterns burned out near midnight.) (The poem's gone with the smoke.) Good. (I said it once. That's enough.)
dlg.bram.festival.spring.before.0: Hm. Blossom Day tomorrow. Juno's making a wreath. Hm. It's heavy. It's iron.
dlg.bram.festival.spring.day.0: Blossom Day. The wreath's on the anvil. Don't touch. Good. Dance if you want.
dlg.bram.festival.spring.after.0: Hm. Petals in the forge. They burned nicely. A short, sweet smell.
dlg.bram.festival.summer.before.0: Hm. Tidewatch tomorrow. I made Felix a hook. Don't tell him. He'll know.
dlg.bram.festival.summer.day.0: Tidewatch. Felix has the new hook. He caught nothing. Hm. Still a good hook.
dlg.bram.festival.summer.after.0: Hm. The hook held. The fish didn't. It's a fair result.
dlg.bram.festival.fall.before.0: Harvest Fair tomorrow. Hm. I forged ribbon pins. Tilda asked. Twelve of them.
dlg.bram.festival.fall.day.0: The fair. Pins on every hat. Hm. A good day for small iron.
dlg.bram.festival.fall.after.0: Hm. Pins everywhere. One's on a pumpkin. Fine. Pumpkins deserve ribbons.
dlg.bram.festival.winter.before.0: Lantern Feast tomorrow. Hm. I made the lantern frames. They hold a candle. They also hold a grudge. Hm.
dlg.bram.festival.winter.day.0: Feast tonight. The frames glow. Hm. Good iron, good light. Sit. Eat.
dlg.bram.festival.winter.after.0: Hm. The feast's done. The frames are warm. Still. I'll keep one by the forge.
dlg.tilda.festival.spring.before.0: Blossom Day tomorrow, dear! I'm selling seed packets in garlands. They're half price. The garlands are free.
dlg.tilda.festival.spring.day.0: Blossom Day! Every packet comes with a blossom today, and a smile if you ask nicely. I'm in my best apron.
dlg.tilda.festival.spring.after.0: Petals in the till, dear. I'll find them for a week. It's the best kind of mess.
dlg.tilda.festival.summer.before.0: The Tidewatch tomorrow. I'm lending Felix my good slate for the scores. It's for the cause.
dlg.tilda.festival.summer.day.0: Tidewatch day, dear. The slate's on the beach and the scores are in chalk. Felix has them upside down.
dlg.tilda.festival.summer.after.0: Felix wrote the scores in capital letters. All twelve, all first place. I let it stand.
dlg.tilda.festival.fall.before.0: Harvest Fair tomorrow, dear! I have ribbons. I have forty ribbons. There are thirty entries. I'm optimistic.
dlg.tilda.festival.fall.day.0: The Fair! Ribbons for everyone, dear, even the cats. Especially the cats.
dlg.tilda.festival.fall.after.0: Forty ribbons given, thirty-nine collected. One's on the cat. It looks very well.
dlg.tilda.festival.winter.before.0: Lantern Feast tomorrow, dear. I'm baking nine pies. One of them is for you. I won't say which.
dlg.tilda.festival.winter.day.0: The Feast, dear. Nine pies, one long table, and a lantern in every window. I put a candle in yours.
dlg.tilda.festival.winter.after.0: The pies are gone, the lanterns are out, and I'm warm all the way through. It was lovely.
dlg.juno.festival.spring.before.0: Blossom Day tomorrow! I made a wreath! It's got a label! It says 'Wreath (Spring)'! Bram says it's heavy!
dlg.juno.festival.spring.day.0: BLOSSOM DAY! The wreath's on my head! It's a little crooked! I labeled the crooked part!
dlg.juno.festival.spring.after.0: Petals in my hair, in my bench, in a clasp! Everything's pink! It's wonderful and a little sticky!
dlg.juno.festival.summer.before.0: Tidewatch tomorrow! I'm making Felix a tiny trophy! It's an anvil! With a fish on it! It doesn't do anything!
dlg.juno.festival.summer.day.0: Tidewatch! Felix is getting the tiny anvil trophy! He cried a bit! I labeled the tear! It says 'Tear (Happy)'!
dlg.juno.festival.summer.after.0: The tiny anvil's on Felix's shelf, next to the best hook! He says it's his most important award! It's a very good anvil!
dlg.juno.festival.fall.before.0: Harvest Fair tomorrow! Bram's making ribbon pins! I'm labeling every one! There are twelve! It's twelve labels!
dlg.juno.festival.fall.day.0: The Fair! Every pin's labeled! 'Pin (Pumpkin)'! 'Pin (Cat)'! It's the best day for tiny things!
dlg.juno.festival.fall.after.0: Twelve pins and twelve labels! One's on a pumpkin! It looks very official! I might cry on a clasp!
dlg.juno.festival.winter.before.0: Lantern Feast tomorrow! I made a lantern with a label! It says 'Lantern (Warm)'! It's four words! I'm proud!
dlg.juno.festival.winter.day.0: The Feast! My lantern's the small one with the label! It glows! It's small and warm and I love it!
dlg.juno.festival.winter.after.0: The lanterns were beautiful! Mine burned until morning! I labeled the ash! It says 'Ash (Good)'!
dlg.piper.festival.spring.before.0: Blossom Day tomorrow! I'm playing the dance! It's one song! It has fourteen verses! You're invited to all of them!
dlg.piper.festival.spring.day.0: BLOSSOM DAY! Front row's a dance floor! I'm on the stool! The song has your name in the third verse!
dlg.piper.festival.spring.after.0: My feet hurt, my throat hurts, and the song's stuck in every head in town! A perfect Blossom Day!
dlg.piper.festival.summer.before.0: The Tidewatch tomorrow! I'm writing Felix a sea shanty! It rhymes 'tide' with 'tried'! I'm so proud!
